checks: Choosing shared occupancy opens roommate profiles with saved people first and preserves home/dates/message.
Co-tenants see waiting status on home and requests; direct inspection, plan-edit and arrangement URLs show status without forbidden forms or ownership errors.
Invitation and final agreement are separate; each tenant accepts for themselves after owner review and inspection.
Confirmed rental waits for key handover; video reports upload successfully and co-tenants can view but not overwrite them.
Confirmed rental change dialog preserves the agreement until both tenants and the owner approve the same proposed full rent.
Administrator requests corrections separately from report resolution, and owner notifications lead to the existing paid advertisement editor.
Account suspension requires explanation, duration and impact acknowledgement; restricted users retain read-only rental access.
